summaries.text: Motor Vehicle Insurance Consumer Protection Act of 1989 - Amends the McCarran-Ferguson Act to limit the antitrust exemption with respect to the business of personal motor vehicle insurance. Provides that this Act shall not be construed to prohibit any State from establishing or approving a residual market mechanism to provide personal motor vehicle insurance.
